facts.fact: Eswatini Positive News says DeltaPay's wallet service is live and lets users send money by Fast Transfer.
Eswatini Positive News says DeltaPay users can send money within seconds, 24/7, to customers of participating banks and digital wallets.
Eswatini Positive News says the Eswatini Payment Switch connects banks and mobile wallets and DeltaPay's service is now live on it.
